name: swift-demo
comment: sampleData is FALSE here DELIBERATELY, and setting it back to true re-opens two filed defects at once. Owner decision, Foundry #1074 (2026-09-13, round-three close-out): the sample-data layer's FIXT*/PACK-* rows are GATE FIXTURES, not browsable demo content. Composed into the storefront a prospect opens they served 12 bare "Placeholder product." strings on the unfiltered /en-us/shop (#1174) and 6 "Sample Group N" values in the PLP facet rail, which is the permanent STOCKCOPY-01 design FAIL (#1127, rail re-screened in #1134). Neither is a rendering bug - both are this line. The fixtures did not move and no id changed: they are composed by editions/gate-fixtures.json, which is where every layer-declared fixture probe now resolves. expectedCounts is pinned rather than derived because Set-ConfigFromEdition derives EcomProducts/EcomGroups from the sampleData toggle alone, which would assert 0/0 on an edition whose catalogue arrives from truvio-demo@1.8.0 (96 product rows = 60 masters + 36 variant rows; 16 groups = 4 top + 12 sub), measured on the e2e host. CONSEQUENCE TO CARRY, not to absorb silently: behaviorProbes are LAYER asserts, so they run for every edition composing the layer. feature-reordering (sku-validation FIXT-0001), feature-pricing (cart-price PACK-RPP-PROD1/PROD2), feature-bom-configurator (bom-cart-lines PACK-BOM-0001), feature-subscription-orders (checkout-recurring PACK-SUB-PROD1) and feature-rma (authenticated /my-returns, which needs buyer 1328 and FIXT-ORDER-RMA1) stay in add[] here because they ship the pages and behaviour this demo shows, but their fixture subjects now exist only in gate-fixtures. The Foundry gate matrix must prove those five legs on gate-fixtures and not on swift-demo. That is a Foundry config change, not a Distribution one.
description: Full Swift storefront demo on the split composition (Swift 2.4): framework-only base + the surface-swift content surface (en-US area + UrlPath + own item types) + six feature layers (feature-reordering + feature-pricing - the P3 split of the retired feature-reordering-pricing - plus feature-rma, feature-subscription-orders, feature-bom-configurator, and feature-b2b-comms - the B2B dealer email pack + onboarding flow) + truvio-demo@1.9.0, proven on the default theme. truvio-demo is the whole catalogue a prospect sees, and since 1.9.0 also the Truvio Commerce storefront copy that replaces surface-swift's Placeholder convention on Home, About, Contact, the header, footer and mega-menu: the Truvio Commerce brand data re-screened against what Swift actually shows - 12 frontend-demonstrable subgroups under 4 top groups, 60 masters + 36 variant rows bound to their axes, 96 customer-group prices, the Images and Manuals asset categories, 324 relations, 12 orders, three personas. It ships NO sample data: the gate's marker fixtures live in the gate-fixtures edition, never in a composition a prospect opens. base-swift composes neither. Proven on DW 10.28.1-PreRelease.
